title: 第13章 点睛之笔
slug: 驱鬼道长全本免费-驱鬼道长最新章节列表
content_zh:
可是，当人们走近一点看，就会发现美中不足得是龙没有眼睛，好好的一条龙，就因为没有眼睛，少了许多生气儿。
大家纷纷请求他，把龙得眼睛点上，可张僧繇解释说：“给龙点上眼珠并不难，但是点上了眼，这龙会破壁飞走的。”
大家听后谁都不相信，认为他这样解释很荒唐，墙上的龙怎么会飞走呢？日子长了，很多人都以为他是在说谎。
张僧繇最后被逼得实在没有办法，只好答应给龙点睛，当着众人的面，提起画笔，轻轻地给龙点上眼睛。
这时奇怪的事情果然发生了，他刚给龙点上眼睛，突然天空乌云密布，狂风四起，雷鸣电闪，在雷电之中，人们看见这条龙震破墙壁，凌空而起，张牙舞爪地腾云驾雾飞向天空。
人们被被眼前的一幕吓得目瞪口呆，看着翱翔于天的龙，一句话都说不出来了。
与画龙点睛的故事一样，这纸人点眼睛也是如此，不过纸人点眼睛之所以能活过来，并非指纸人本身会活，而是指会有一些孤魂野鬼趁虚而入，附入纸人身上，从而使纸人变活。
废话不多说，进入正题。
一切准备就绪后，老头又吩咐我妈找来九个瓷碗，并且每个碗里盛三分之一小米，随后他盘膝坐地，将碗摆在他身体的周围，用一根红绳将九个瓷碗缠绕，串联起来成为一体。
红绳正好呈现一个红色圆圈，把他的身体包围起来，这时老头又拾起三柱檀香点燃，放在头顶，拜了几拜，依次在每个碗里插上，共计插上三九二十七柱香。
这檀香点燃的不一会，屋里便烟雾袅袅，白蒙蒙的一片，老头的身影也变得若隐若离起来。
做完这些，老头就迫不及待的吩咐我妈，赶快把纸人纸轿依次放入事先准备好的铁盆里点燃。
不过当我妈拿起火柴划着，向纸人送去的时候，没想到，奇怪的事情还发生了。
只见突然自窗外吹进了一阵风，顷刻间，我妈手中的火柴瞬间就被风吹的灭掉了。
我妈略一犹豫，就想再次划着一根，让她吃惊的是，无论她怎么划，火柴就是不着，一时间，急的她是满头大汗，不知所措。
“不用划了！”老头喊了我妈一声叫她停手，随即凝神注视着四只纸人的其中一个，淡淡开口道：“没想到我刚点上眼睛，你就钻了进来，是你自己滚，还是让我把你打个魂飞魄散？”
说完，老头右手抬于胸前，无名指和小指弯屈，拇指压在二指的指甲上，食指中指并拢伸直，结成了一个手决，此手决名为剑指，有辟邪杀鬼之功效，还可以护自身不受恶鬼侵害。
老头的剑指刚一结成，其中一个纸人就发出莎莎的声响，身子突然动了一下。
它竟然抬起头作揖求饶道：“道长息怒，我并没有恶意，我本是孤魂野鬼一只，路过此地，闻到了香火味，所以才附了纸人的身，想讨点钱花，还请先生可怜可怜我，烧纸人的时候，顺带给我烧上一些纸钱。”
说完，那个纸人不停地向老头拱手作揖，看的我爸妈双眼瞪的老大，他们何时见过这种诡异的事情，各自面面相觑，嘴唇哆嗦着说不出话来。

“原来是个穷鬼，你倒是会找时机趁虚而入，我答应你，不过只此一次，下不为例！”老头哑然一笑，散了剑指，随即吩咐我妈去找些纸钱，给它烧下，打发走便是。
我妈连忙应了一声，跑进厢房拿回一沓纸钱，蹲在火盆旁，颤抖着划着火柴，把那些纸钱点燃烧掉。
等到纸钱烧成灰烬的时候，突然火盆里凭空卷起一阵风，带着纸灰顺着窗户打个转儿，向外飞去，随之，那个纸人脑袋吧嗒一歪，站在原地一动不动了。
“好了，让这个穷鬼耽误一些时间，赶快把纸人纸轿烧掉，莫要在被其它过路的野鬼趁虚而入，到时候免不得还要费一番手脚打发它们。”老头对我爸妈催促道。
有了穷鬼这个插曲，我爸妈不敢怠慢，生怕纸人在被附身活过来，他们三下五除二把纸人纸轿全部扔进火盆，一把火给点了。
等到纸人纸轿燃烧殆尽，全是黑灰的时候，老头便一脸凝重的对我爸妈讲道：“一会我走了之后千万不可触碰我的身体，以免破了我的法术，还有，这瓷碗里的檀香为续命香，代表着我的性命，千万不可令其灭掉！如果发现有灭掉的迹象，用最短的时间换上一根，切记，切记！”

content_en:
However, when people look closer, they will find that the only flaw is that the dragon has no eyes. A good dragon loses a lot of life just because it has no eyes.
Everyone asked him to add eyes to the dragon, but Zhang Sengyao explained: "It is not difficult to add eyes to a dragon, but if you add eyes, the dragon will break through the wall and fly away."
After hearing this, no one believed it. They thought his explanation was ridiculous. How could the dragon on the wall fly away? As time went by, many people thought he was lying.
In the end, Zhang Sengyao was forced to dot the dragon's eyes, so he agreed to dot the dragon's eyes. In front of everyone, he picked up the brush and gently dotted the dragon's eyes.
At this time, a strange thing happened. As soon as he put the eyes on the dragon, suddenly the sky was covered with dark clouds, strong winds, thunder and lightning. In the thunder and lightning, people saw the dragon break through the wall, rise into the sky, and fly into the sky through the clouds and fog with bared teeth and claws.
People were stunned by the scene in front of them. They were speechless as they looked at the dragon soaring in the sky.
Just like the finishing touch story, the paper man’s eyes are also the same. However, the reason why the paper man’s eyes can come back to life does not mean that the paper man himself will live, but that some lonely ghosts will take advantage of the void and attach themselves to the paper man, thus making the paper man come alive.
Without further ado, let’s get to the point.
After everything was ready, the old man asked my mother to find nine porcelain bowls, and fill each bowl with one-third of millet. Then he sat cross-legged on the ground, placed the bowls around his body, and wrapped the nine porcelain bowls with a red rope and connected them into one.
The red rope just formed a red circle, surrounding his body. At this time, the old man picked up three pillars of sandalwood and lit them, placed them on his head, bowed several times, and inserted them into each bowl in turn, for a total of 3927 pillars of incense.
After the sandalwood was lit for a while, the room became filled with smoke and white, and the old man's figure became vague.
After doing this, the old man couldn't wait to tell my mother to quickly put the paper figures and paper sedans into the prepared iron basin and light them.
But when my mother picked up the match, struck it, and sent it to the paper man, unexpectedly, something strange happened.
I saw a sudden gust of wind blowing in from the window. In an instant, the match in my mother's hand was blown out by the wind.
After a slight hesitation, my mother wanted to strike a match again. What surprised her was that no matter how she struck, the match would not light. For a moment, she was so anxious that she was sweating profusely and at a loss.
"No need to scratch!" The old man called my mother to stop. Then he stared at one of the four paper figures and said calmly: "I didn't expect you to get in as soon as I lit my eyes. Do you want to get out of here, or do you want me to beat you to death?"
After saying that, the old man raised his right hand in front of his chest, with his ring finger and little finger bent, his thumb pressing on the nails of his second finger, his index and middle fingers together and straightened, forming a hand sword. This hand sword is called sword finger, which has the effect of warding off evil spirits and killing ghosts, and can also protect oneself from evil spirits.
As soon as the old man's sword fingers formed, one of the paper figures made a rustling sound and suddenly moved.
It actually raised its head and bowed and begged for mercy: "Master, please calm down, I have no ill intentions. I was just a lonely wild ghost. I passed by this place and smelled the scent of incense, so I possessed the paper man's body and wanted to ask for some money. Please have mercy on me, sir. When you burn the paper man, you can burn some paper money for me."
After saying that, the paper man kept bowing to the old man, which made my parents’ eyes widen. They had never seen such a weird thing before. They each looked at each other, their lips were trembling and they were speechless.
"It turned out to be a poor man, but you will find an opportunity to take advantage of it. I promise you, but it's just this once, and it won't happen next time!" The old man smiled hoarsely, loosened his sword finger, and then ordered my mother to find some paper money, burn it, and send it away.
My mother quickly respondedWith a cry, he ran into the side room and retrieved a stack of paper money. He squatted by the brazier, tremblingly struck a match and burned the paper money.
When the paper money was burned to ashes, suddenly a gust of wind blew up out of thin air in the brazier, carrying the paper ashes around the window and flying out. Then, the paper man's head tilted and he stood motionless.
"Okay, let this poor guy waste some time and burn the paper man and paper sedan quickly. Don't let other passing wild ghosts take advantage of it. Otherwise, you will have to spend a lot of time to get rid of them." The old man urged my parents.
With the episode about the poor man, my parents did not dare to neglect, for fear that the paper man would be possessed and come to life, so they threw all the paper men and paper sedans into the brazier and lit the fire.
When the paper man and paper sedan were burned out and turned into black ashes, the old man said to my parents solemnly: "Don't touch my body after I leave, so as not to break my spell. Also, the sandalwood in this porcelain bowl is a life-sustaining incense, which represents my life. You must not let it go out! If you find any signs of being extinguished, replace it with one as soon as possible. Remember, remember!"
